proposition: After a committed retained-grant claim, the ledger view leaves the delegated effect unresolved. BMO's existing applied settlement supports that effect, and BMO's existing definite no-effect settlement refutes it. Both continuations match the classical settlement contract on the shared ledger prefix and on the continuation's own settlement record.
scope: r3-ledger-settlement-v1 committed claim followed by BMO SettleOrdinaryRetryFirstEditTx or SettleOrdinaryRetryFirstEditNoEffectTx; not a replacement for the retained r3-ledger-claim-v1 calibration
label: classical_baseline_matches
